Sentence (English): I really appreciate the special care given to the arrangement for storing the dishes.
Comments (English): [ Complete dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I really appreciate the special care given to the arrangement for storing the dishes. The basic programs are numerous and the options just as many, it is even possible to download others from the application. I chose this model for its consumption in ECO mode and I plan to save money now. The sound emitted is acceptable and will not bother me at night. The only negative point, at least, has been greatly improved: the user interface of the mobile application is not intuitive, the alternating line inserts make the pages difficult to read, there is a lack of a UX/UI designer worthy of the name. Also, the reaction time of the buttons on the edge of the door allowing you to configure and control the dishwasher is sometimes a little long or does not react. Would a firmware update improve this negative point? I recommend.
Comments (Original): [ Lave vaisselle complet ] || ---------------- || J’apprécie beaucoup le soin particulier donné à l’amménagement pour ranger la vaisselle.Les programmes de base sont nombreux et les options tout autant, il est même possible d’en télécharger d’autres depuis l’application.J’ai choisi ce modèle pour sa consommation en mode ECO et je compte faire des économies à présent.Le son émis est acceptable et ne me dérangera pas la nuit.Seul point négatif, du moins, à grandement amélioré : l’interface utilisateur de l’application mobile, peut intuitive, les encarts alternant de ligne rendent peu lisible les pages, il manque de designer UX/UI digne de ce nom.Aussi, le temps de réaction des touches sur la tranche de la porte permettant de paramétrer, contrôler le lave vaisselle sont parfois un peu long ou ne réagissent pas.Une mise à jour du firmware permettrait-elle d’améliorer ce point négatif ?Je recommande.

Sentence (English): First of all, a very nice design with a display on the front and also on the inside of the top edge.
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher ] || ---------------- || First of all, a very nice design with a display on the front and also on the inside of the top edge. Countless programs and favorites can also be set via the app. I recently forgot to turn on the dishwasher before bed. Comments (Original): [ Geweldige vaatwasser ] || ---------------- || Ten eerste een heel mooi design met display aan de voorkant en ook binnen op de bovenrand. Apparaat heeft ook een mooie sjieke binnenverlichting. Makkelijke indeling met in hoogte verstelbare rekken. Besteklade was even wennen, maar werkt super goed! Hij is lekker zuinig wat voor ons ook belangrijk is. Voor een vrijstaande vaatwasser is deze zeker een aanrader. Vaat komt er droog en uiteraard schoon uit!

Comments (English): [ Auntie, you are truly the best. ] || ---------------- || I finally bought a Samsung Bespoke dishwasher after much deliberation. Even washing the dishes hurt my wrists, so my husband always did them. But when I didn't have time, the pile of dishes would be frustrating, and my hands would hurt too much if I did them myself. After much deliberation, I finally decided to buy it before my wrist surgery. Installation was incredibly fast. Coupang is a rocket ship. They installed the dishwasher the next day and installed it the next. It arrived very quickly. They explained everything so kindly and were very helpful. I now understand why people treat dishwashers like their aunts and uncles. I just rinsed the dirty items in water and tossed them in. It was quieter than I expected, and it took a while, but the drying process was a revelation. I should have bought it sooner. With its high-heat, hot air dryer, and disinfectant, it's cleaner than doing the dishes myself. I've been using Frog, my most-used detergent, and it makes a huge difference. There's no odor or water stains. It's great. The dryer was a revelation, and I'm so glad I bought the dishwasher now. It definitely helps my hands feel less sore, and I think I'll continue to receive good treatment thanks to Auntie Siksegi.

Sentence (English): I've been thinking about the dishwasher for 3 months since moving.
Comments (English): I've been thinking about the dishwasher for 3 months since moving. I wanted a nice 12-person built-in, but there's no space in my house to put it in, and I didn't want to do any construction work. I moved in after the interior was already done, so I was absolutely against construction work that would produce dust. I live in a house with a picky preschool son and a picky husband. My mom prepares all the side dishes, so I just have to heat them up and eat them. But I didn't want to wash the dishes that come out, so I decided to buy a countertop for 6 people after much thought. First, I have to put it on the sink, so it can't be too flashy. Second, I'm not going to make it look fancy with a built-in anyway, and it's for convenience, so it doesn't have to be expensive. Third, no matter what, I searched for Samsung or L*. Coupang has a huge discount on the white color without shipping. I checked the blog reviews with the product number and thought, "This is good enough." I ordered it on Sunday morning. It was delivered and installed on Tuesday morning. As expected, Coupang is the best, and there's no shipping fee. The appointment time was 9 AM. I got a call 5 minutes before the arrival and the two technicians arrived on time. It was a very busy time in the morning, taking care of the childcare and getting ready for work, but the two of them installed it quickly and professionally without any hassle, finished checking everything themselves, explained it with impact, and cleaned up after themselves neatly and left without being late. I was so excited that I left. They didn't even say anything like "Please remove the water like this", but they did it exactly how I wanted. However, the color is not white but closer to beige. I put half of the frog detergent in the dishes and turned it on. It turned on for about an hour and it was washed well without any water stains. I'm still not good at Tetris, so I don't know how to put in a lot of water. It was my first time using it and it was successful. Oily plastics? Lunch boxes were also clean. It was much cleaner than when I did it by hand, and when I finished, I checked the automatic door opening and opened it with my hand, and the hot air escaped and the remaining water dried well. The dishes inside that were not too dry were easy to clean by wiping them once to remove moisture. I am not the type of person who can do a lot of dishes all at once, so I often turn it over or do it myself often because I feel bad about wasting water, electricity, and detergent. At this price, I think it will be worth it even if I only use it when I wash a lot of dishes. In conclusion, it is very good. Should I buy it or not? Will I be able to use it well? Do I really need it? I don't want to waste time worrying about these things. If I have it, I will use it. ***

Sentence (English): Should I buy it or not?
Comments (English): I've been thinking about the dishwasher for 3 months since moving. I wanted a nice 12-person built-in, but there's no space in my house to put it in, and I didn't want to do any construction work. I moved in after the interior was already done, so I was absolutely against construction work that would produce dust. I live in a house with a picky preschool son and a picky husband. My mom prepares all the side dishes, so I just have to heat them up and eat them. But I didn't want to wash the dishes that come out, so I decided to buy a countertop for 6 people after much thought. First, I have to put it on the sink, so it can't be too flashy. Second, I'm not going to make it look fancy with a built-in anyway, and it's for convenience, so it doesn't have to be expensive. Third, no matter what, I searched for Samsung or L*. Coupang has a huge discount on the white color without shipping. I checked the blog reviews with the product number and thought, "This is good enough." I ordered it on Sunday morning. It was delivered and installed on Tuesday morning. As expected, Coupang is the best, and there's no shipping fee. The appointment time was 9 AM. I got a call 5 minutes before the arrival and the two technicians arrived on time. It was a very busy time in the morning, taking care of the childcare and getting ready for work, but the two of them installed it quickly and professionally without any hassle, finished checking everything themselves, explained it with impact, and cleaned up after themselves neatly and left without being late. I was so excited that I left. They didn't even say anything like "Please remove the water like this", but they did it exactly how I wanted. However, the color is not white but closer to beige. I put half of the frog detergent in the dishes and turned it on. It turned on for about an hour and it was washed well without any water stains. I'm still not good at Tetris, so I don't know how to put in a lot of water. It was my first time using it and it was successful. Oily plastics? Lunch boxes were also clean. It was much cleaner than when I did it by hand, and when I finished, I checked the automatic door opening and opened it with my hand, and the hot air escaped and the remaining water dried well. The dishes inside that were not too dry were easy to clean by wiping them once to remove moisture. I am not the type of person who can do a lot of dishes all at once, so I often turn it over or do it myself often because I feel bad about wasting water, electricity, and detergent. At this price, I think it will be worth it even if I only use it when I wash a lot of dishes. In conclusion, it is very good. Should I buy it or not? Will I be able to use it well? Do I really need it? I don't want to waste time worrying about these things. If I have it, I will use it. ***

Sentence (English): Firstly, this dishwasher cleans like a dream.
Comments (English): [ Cleans Great, Lots of Design Problems for Me ] || ---------------- || Firstly, this dishwasher cleans like a dream. I've been happy with how well it gets everything clean and dry - even tea stained mugs. Top rack items too. But I have a lot of nits with this that make me miss my crappy, cheaply made Whirlpool. I've had it for almost three months and so far I like how it washes, but:- The silverware racks are on the side of the rack and not the door. Meaning you have to open the door and pull out the bottom rack to drop simple items into the silverware rack. I never appreciated a door mounted rack until now.- The silverware rack CONSTANTLY pops off when removing silverware. It only hangs on the size of the dish rack and doesn't clip in. I'm going to zip tie it down to save my sanity.- The LED indicator tells you how long it will run UNTIL you start it and close the door. Once it's closed you have no idea how many hours/minutes are left. You only have the red light that beams onto the floor.- Once it's done running, there's no indicator that it's done or if I forgot to start it. So I've been using the auto-air feature to pop open the dishwasher when it's done.- The door hinge doesn't allow for the door to be slightly ajar. It either is fully closed or open six inches. On my old DW, I liked to keep the door ajar to let some air in to cool and dry the dishes. Except this model requires the door to be open really wide so you can catch it with your hip when you walk by.- Finally, and most annoying, the tines on the bottom rack are slanted and very close together. That's fine for plates, but not for pots or other large items. Big things won't fit between the tines so they're cockeyed and will hit the washing arm. I have to set my pots on top of them and therefore can't fit as much into the rack.

For the pricepoint on this dishwasher - save yourself the trouble and get something else. Also - as other reviews have mentioned - poor design so there is not much room for dishes if you have a bigger family. Whirpool - I need a replacement or credit towards a new unit.

Each time a tech comes out and 'fixes' it only to have it do the same thing again the next time I run a dishwasher load. The  last time the tech came out - he called the Whirpool tech line. He was told the blinking light was an error code for improper draining. So they left it at that and told me to have a plumber come fix the drain line connected to the garbage disposal so that it was 'higher on the right side' and that would fix the issue. Did as I was told. Guess what? Still did the same thing! I realized in looking through the reviews that this is a common issue so I am guessing there is a fault in the design. For the pricepoint on this dishwasher - save yourself the trouble and get something else. Also - as other reviews have mentioned - poor design so there is not much room for dishes if you have a bigger family.  Whirpool - I need a replacement or credit towards a new unit.

After two more calls and a trip to Lowes I was told they would look into it and get back to me the next day. I heard nothing for several more days so I went back to Lowes and a rep said there was a glitch in the system so I suggested they cancel the order and let me order it again. The nice sales rep agreed and finally, they delivered the dishwasher yesterday. So as you can see returning it because of a few dents didn't seem like the best idea considering I had taken my old dishwasher out a month ago before the first time they were supposed to deliver. Comments (English): [ Surprise fee from installer, Broke after 3 weeks! ] || ---------------- || Installer charged an extra fee of $200 claiming they must install a power cord on the dishwasher and an electric outlet for it although the local electric code does not require it. The old dishwasher was hardwired. The manual for the new dishwasher showed it can be hardwired. After three weeks the dishwasher stopped working and displayed an EFEE code. Whirlpool sent a repair person within a week. The error indicated the control board may be defective and the service person did not have one. He turned off and on the electric power which cleared the error and the dishwasher worked. However I was concerned that it might have future issues so returned it and got a new replacement. Costco customer service was very helpful in communicating with Whirlpool and expediting the replacement. I will continue to buy from Costco.

Sentence (English): We should be given option to provide review of product, customer service and the installer.
Comments (English): [ Good Dishwasher, Bad Shipping, Worse Installation ] || ---------------- || We should be given option to provide review of product, customer service and the installer. Since there is no way to do that I tried to provide review for each as Good, bad and worse. Good: The dishwasher looks good and cleans well. Its been a week and no leaking. I think it's a bit more noisy than 44 db. Added to it, the drying fan comes on after the wash with a humming sound for more than an hour. This is after a regular cycle, not the pro wash cycle or the pro heating option. I thought something was broken initially. Bad: Costco shipped incorrect model. With all the experience in logistics Costco has, you would expect that correct and only the ordered item will be shipped. There was a slight difference in the model numbers between towel handle model KDTM604KPS and the push handle KDPM604KPS so I got the wrong model. Worse: The installer, who is a local plumbing and electric company called Home Solutions, came over with the order form/pick up form where the model# was clearly written but didn't bother to check the model# on the item they picked from Costco's delivery center. On top of it, they removed my existing dishwasher and then brought in the new one. Upon seeing the new one I informed them that it was the incorrect model and asked them to put in the old one back. They refused citing some liability issues. So we had to manually wash our dishes for two weeks until the correct model arrived and installed. No one - the installer or Costco took responsibility for what happened. Worse continued - When I talked to Costco's customer service, they had mixed messages initially but finally stuck to the message that a new one need to be ordered and it will be delivered in 2 weeks. When I asked about compensating for the pain and frustration we have to go through, they said I should call back after the correct item is installed. I didn't understand why I had to call back and when I did the credit they gave me was laughable when compared to the 2 weeks of pain and frustration we had to go through. Mind you, this is not from something we did wrong. Nothing was in our control except for ordering it on Costco.com. Anyway, we got unlucky and had a bad experience with both Costco and the installer. So no stars for Costco or the installer.

It's quiet; but you'll know it's running a room away. It dries as effectively as dishwasher with a heating element; so long as the auto air/dry feature is used and the door left open for a few hours/overnight. The third rack is great for utensils and serving spoons; but not big enough for much else. If I run things on auto, everything comes out clean. If I try speed 60, not as clean and not worth the chance and eventual redo. Biggest gripe? WiFi. Why? Why does everything need to be connected? Why can't I delay start on the machine itself? Second biggest gripe, the touch panel. Way to finicky. Would have much preferred physical buttons. Persnickety gripe. Finish advertisement sticker on inside lip of machine is not removable. If you try to, it's not pretty. I shouldn't be advertised to every time I open the dishwasher I now own. Especially when I don't, and won't, use or support Finish. Further, to note, I've only run into one issue this thus far (albeit it's consistent). When I hit start and select my settings and close the door, the machine beeps at me and the red light flashes (never starting). I have to open, tap start again, and then close. Makes no sense and app provides no insight. Would I buy this specific model if I had to do it over again? Probably not. I'd either get the older model sans WiFi, or a different brand. Please, please please. Not everything needs to be connected to the internet. Consumers aren't asking for this. We just want to clean our dishes without the need to stay connected to one more device, one more app.

Anyway, other than that one thing, I’m satisfied!

Sentence (English): We recently had to replace our old dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ A bit noisy but great value ] || ---------------- || We recently had to replace our old dishwasher. The Haier was the most affordable we could find at short notice. The unit was easily installed and up & running within 20 minutes of unpacking. I have "tradie" skills, but I reckon anyone capable of crawling around on the floor and under cabinets should be able to manage.The trays are as you'd expect of a modern dishwasher, although the bottom tray is not adjustable to create flat areas for pots and pans. It makes it a little awkward to place a number of them, especially larger ones, because the plate racks stick up (see photo). The upper tray's two position height adjustment is useful and somewhat necessary given the non adjustable bottom tray (see above); tall pots such as stock pots will need the additional height the top shelf can provide.We didn't like the cutlery holder, which takes up a bit of room and is fiddly. We use a third party one that we'd procured some time ago for the previous dishwasher. Program selection is straight forward. There are a number of different cycles that can be selected. We find the Light (90 minute) cycle works for our 2 person household. HANDY HINT: Read the instructions first.As others have observed, this dishwasher is noisy, especially when compared to our previous unit. Not bad noisy, you just know it's working. However, I have noticed that with large loads the noise is less noticeable.The dishwasher runs very hot, so best to wait for a few minutes before opening the door at the end of cycle.Drying is reasonably effective and dishes do come out sparkling clean. All in all, if it proves as reliable as it is effective, the HAIER HDW13V1W1 will be good value.

Whirlpool dried dishes better, probably by wasting a lot of energy heating the interior (dishes were way too hot to handle when it just finished). Seems like a lot of new dishwashers have long cycle times, this one is 2.5 hours, an hour longer than old dishwasher. Overall, very pleased with the new Samsung. The big issue I don't know right now is will it last 20+ years like the old whirlpool. I'm hoping I don't regret choosing design and quietness (kitchen is open to the living and dining room) over the reliably of the whirlpool.

It dries as effectively as dishwasher with a heating element; so long as the auto air/dry feature is used and the door left open for a few hours/overnight. You'll still have puddles in cup buttoms, but few dishwashers can dry everything. It loads well; but given the tines are angled, it's up to Bosch, not you, how you load things effectively. The third rack is great for utensils and serving spoons; but not big enough for much else. If I run things on auto, everything comes out clean. If I try speed 60, not as clean and not worth the chance and eventual redo. Biggest gripe? WiFi. Why? Why does everything need to be connected? Why can't I delay start on the machine itself? Second biggest gripe, the touch panel. Way to finicky. Would have much preferred physical buttons. Persnickety gripe... Finish advertisement sticker on inside lip of machine is not removable. If you try to, it's not pretty. I shouldn't be advertised to every time I open the dishwasher I now own. Especially when I don't, and won't, use or support Finish. Further, to note, I've only run into one issue this thus far (albeit it's consistent). When I hit start and select my settings and close the door, the machine beeps at me and the red light flashes (never starting). I have to open, tap start again, and then close. Makes no sense and app provides no insight. Would I buy this specific model if I had to do it over again? Probably not. I'd either get the older model sans WiFi, or a different brand. Please, please please... Not everything needs to be connected to the internet. Consumers aren't asking for this. We just want to clean our dishes without the need to stay connected to one more device, one more app.

Outside of that, we haven't used it in atleast a month or so because we are concerned with water always being in there and maybe leaking. Sentence (English): I purchased this dishwasher to replace one that would have been too costly to repair.
Comments (English): [ Super quiet dishwasher that cleans amazingly ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher to replace one that would have been too costly to repair. I remember that over 40 years ago my grandmother had a Kitchenaid dishwasher and I still remember how clean the dishes always came out. I started doing my research. I knew I wanted a dishwasher with a stainless steel tub and a "useable" 3rd rack. Since I was replacing an existing dishwasher, installation was very easy. I did have to purchase a longer drain hose and the fitting on the dishwasher side was larger than the hose that came with the dishwasher. Some rubber tape and a radiator clamp took care of that issue. The water connection is a 3/4" "garden hose" style connector. I had to purchase an adapter for my installation. This dishwasher is QUIET! You can barely hear it at all compared to my previous one. The amount of dishes this dishwasher holds is INCREDIBLE! The racks are very well laid out and the design makes it flexible to load a large amount of dishes. I've used the 3rd rack for bowls, cups, silverware, and cooking utensils. The racks slide in and out easily, even when loaded. The door springs are heavy-duty so I do not expect the door to sag. The controls are easy to access and intuitive. The active drying feature helps to dry the dishes which eliminates spotting. I am also using the rinse agent which I'm sure helps. Now the most important part of this review: the dishes come out CLEAN; just like grandma's. Highly recommend this product to anyone in need of a new dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I bought this unit in October 2023 with the expectation that an American Made product would be a winner.
Comments (English): [ It's shiny and looks great in my kitchen, BUT. ] || ---------------- || I bought this unit in October 2023 with the expectation that an American Made product would be a winner. When it comes to "fit and finish" it appears to be well made. However, our experience with the unit since we installed it has "honestly" been a disappointment. After the fist couple of washes the unit started to develope problems. During the 3rd wash, it threw an error code saying the overflow device located on the bottom of the washer was not working. I pulled the lower cover and re-seated the connection and the washer returned to normal. That was short-lived! The washer shuts off during runs. It's very random with no real pattern. During a cycle be it a long or short one the unit just pauses for no apparent reason. Thankfully, you can restart the unit and in most cases, it will complete the cycle however if you start the unit at the end of the day you may not notice it stopped during the cycle until the following morning. This is a major disappointment. I discussed this with the seller (HomeDepot). They said I have a one year warranty take up the problem with them. Frankly, I don't have confidence in the warranty. If the problem persists I guess I'll have to pursue the warranty. I live in a rural setting and I just don't have the energy to start the hassle of dealing with the manufacturer at this point. If the unit continues to give me problems I guess we will have to "suck it up" and take on the manufacturer. It's American-made. Come on. why can't they get it right.

Sentence (English): Loving it so far.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher, WiFi is 2.4 GHz only ] || ---------------- || Loving it so far. Super quiet. Crystal Dry is amazing. Not too many bells and whistles. Worth the cost. At first I had issues connecting to the app, and after some trial and error, I found out it was because the dishwasher WiFi is 2.4 GHz only. I use an eero mesh internet system that automatically toggles between 2.4 and 5 GHz, and when a device is 2.4 GHz only it can sometimes have issues connecting. This is not a fault of Bosch's but moreso the eero design in my opinion. I was happy when I could finally get it to connect. I wish the dishwasher showed the remaining time on the display while it is running, but I will now use the app for that.

Sentence (English): I recently had the opportunity to experience the wonder of modern technology in my kitchen with the Bosch fully integrated dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Efficiency and Elegance Defined ] || ---------------- || I recently had the opportunity to experience the wonder of modern technology in my kitchen with the Bosch fully integrated dishwasher. This appliance has not only exceeded my expectations, but has also raised the bar for what I consider essential in a modern home. The first thing that stands out is its fully integrable design. It blends perfectly with the aesthetic of my kitchen, maintaining a clean and minimalist look. Being hidden behind a facade that matches the cabinets, this dishwasher becomes a discreet and elegant element. In terms of functionality, this dishwasher is a gem. With multiple washing programs, it adapts to different types of dishes and levels of dirt, always ensuring an impeccable result. Its sensor technology automatically adjusts wash duration and water consumption, which translates into energy efficiency and savings on your water bill. The noise level is another point to highlight. Furthermore, ease of use is an aspect that I cannot fail to mention. The control panel is intuitive and accessible, making selecting the right program a simple and hassle-free process. This ease extends to the maintenance of the device. Cleaning is simple, and the filters can be removed and cleaned effortlessly, ensuring the dishwasher always operates at peak performance. Bosch innovation also shines in the additional features this model offers. They include Home Connect technology, which allows you to control and monitor the dishwasher through a mobile application. This functionality adds a layer of convenience and modernity, allowing me to start or schedule wash cycles from anywhere. Attention to detail is evident in every aspect of the dishwasher's design. From the internal layout that maximizes space to the efficient drying system. A marvel
Comments (Original): [ Eficiencia y Elegancia Definidas ] || ---------------- || Recientemente tuve la oportunidad de experimentar la maravilla de la tecnología moderna en mi cocina con el lavavajillas totalmente integrable de Bosch. Este electrodoméstico no solo ha superado mis expectativas, sino que también ha elevado el estándar de lo que considero esencial en un hogar moderno.Lo primero que destaca es su diseño totalmente integrable. Se fusiona perfectamente con la estética de mi cocina, manteniendo una apariencia limpia y minimalista. Al estar oculto detrás de una fachada que coincide con los gabinetes, este lavavajillas se convierte en un elemento discreto y elegante.En términos de funcionalidad, este lavavajillas es una joya. Con múltiples programas de lavado, se adapta a diferentes tipos de vajilla y niveles de suciedad, asegurando siempre un resultado impecable. Su tecnología de sensores ajusta automáticamente la duración del lavado y el consumo de agua, lo que se traduce en eficiencia energética y ahorro en la factura de agua.El nivel de ruido es otro punto a destacar. Además, la facilidad de uso es un aspecto que no puedo dejar de mencionar. El panel de control es intuitivo y accesible, lo que hace que seleccionar el programa adecuado sea un proceso sencillo y sin complicaciones. Esta facilidad se extiende al mantenimiento del aparato. La limpieza es sencilla, y los filtros se pueden retirar y limpiar sin esfuerzo, asegurando que el lavavajillas funcione siempre a su máximo rendimiento.La innovación de Bosch también brilla en las características adicionales que ofrece este modelo. incluyen la tecnología Home Connect, que permite controlar y monitorear el lavavajillas a través de una aplicación móvil. Esta funcionalidad agrega una capa de comodidad y modernidad, permitiéndome iniciar o programar ciclos de lavado desde cualquier lugar.La atención al detalle se nota en cada aspecto del diseño del lavavajillas. Desde la distribución interna que maximiza el espacio hasta el sistema de secado eficiente. Una maravilla

Sentence (English): The product is good, but the installation process after purchase is not pleasant.
Comments (English): [ The product is good, but the installation process after purchase is not pleasant. My parents' house. ] || ---------------- || The product is good, but the installation process after purchase is not pleasant. I sent it to my parents' house as a gift, but the technician who came for a preliminary inspection said that there was a problem with the sink and ruled that it could not be installed. So, I paid 450,000 won to a private company to repair the sink and requested an installer to complete the installation. I don't think the sink repair process is that difficult of a technique, but if Samsung repairs and installs the sink for a fee rather than determining it as impossible to install during the pre-inspection, Samsung will have the effect of additionally increasing sales, and users will also feel that the installation process is smooth and excellent, and they will use it for other products in the future. I think you will also think positively about purchasing products. Additionally, the process of rescheduling the installation after sink repair was too cumbersome. I think it would be more efficient to change the system to one where the gift recipient can contact the technician directly to schedule the installation. I thought I could make a schedule on the web by purchasing it from Samsung's official website, but it was impossible. The buyer said he had to contact the customer service center directly, so I called him directly, but to specify the desired date, the recipient must receive a KakaoTalk message from the center and specify the date. They said there was no other way. When the recipient contacts the driver, wouldn't it be more efficient if the driver sends a KakaoTalk message that allows the driver to specify a date and the recipient specifies the date? For me, who believes in the corporate image of Samsung and enjoys using Samsung products, this purchase process was taken so seriously that it raised doubts that Samsung's organization had become so large that it was falling into a bureaucratic swamp of inefficiency. Looks like it needs improvement.

Sentence (English): We ordered this dishwasher to replace an older Bosch dishwasher that was starting to fail.
Comments (English): [ Do NOT Buy Bosch Appliances from Lowes! ] || ---------------- || We ordered this dishwasher to replace an older Bosch dishwasher that was starting to fail. We love Bosch appliances and have had great success with them. The Lowes drivers left the appliance in my garage, and THEY signed for the delivery. My weekend project was to replace the dishwasher which is now 4 days later. When I opened the dishwasher, the top left corner was smashed in. There was no way you could tell this from the outside of the package. Either the unit had been dropped or something was dropped on it. Regardless, the unit is destroyed and not usable. I thought that resolving this issue with Lowes would be no issue at all. Wow was I wrong! Lowes will NOT stand behind the product, their delivery service or help me in any way with this situation. Customer service states that there is no return or exchange allowed because it has been more than 48 hours and that my only option is to contact my bank. My bank. really? I'm extremely disappointed that this is the best Lowes can do given the circumstances. The Bosch packaging is clearly not up to the task of shipping these units long distances. There is very little padding or support on the corners when you open the packaging. To recap, the only options I have from Lowes are to contact my bank or try to fix it myself so that we at least have something usable. They didn't even ask for pictures or more information. basically they just want to get you off the phone as quickly as possible. My recommendation. DO NOT BUY appliances from Lowes! Consider using a local appliance shop that will actually stand behind the product and their overall service including delivery. Bosch should also consider their relationship with these big box stores because these negative experiences unfortunately reflect on them as well. Their packaging isn't up to the standards necessary to stand up to the abuse from these retail companies. Bosch may be the only one here that can advocate for the consumer and ensure their resellers are treating the customer fairly. It was abundantly clear in dealing with customer service that Lowes DOES NOT CARE about us as the customer. Overall, this was an extremely disappointing and frustrating situation and will cause me to shop elsewhere in the future.

Sentence (English): Spent hours researching dishwashers.
Comments (English): [ Cleans and dries like a dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || Spent hours researching dishwashers. YouTube videos, online reviews, Consumer Reports, etc. Decided on this one for a few reasons: brand reliability, no heating element, third rack, and general options available (such as sanitation and NSF rating). It cleans well and dries well - if and only if you use the auto dry feature and leave it opened for a couple/few hours. Mugs and the like with indentions still puddle with water, but it's no different than a standard dishwasher (with heating element). Third rack is nice, but I think KitchenAid's seems better; with this one there's not much room for anything bigger than a than a serving spoon or Yeti lids. But I can put all my utensils there and not use the basket and thus free up space in the bottom rack, so that's a win. Nearly every review notes how quiet it is. Sure, it's quiet, but you know it's running - even from a room away. The red light that projects on the floor to let you know it's running is super cool, though. The biggest con/drawback is the wifi nature of this machine. You can't set the timer on the machine itself - only via the janky app. (Why does everything have to be wifi enabled! ) The touch \"buttons\" are very finiky, and I wish it had physical buttons, but that's the way of things it seems. Overall, I'm pleased, but if I had it to do over again, I would have sought out the still available, but harder to find, non wifi version. Or maybe even the KitchenAid. Time will tell if it holds up, but so far so good.
